text:
Type: illustrated kids' play rug
Use: playing on the floor, softening floors; kids' room, nursery, playroom
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: low pile synthetic fibers with a printed illustration
Colors: bright pink, turquoise blue, lime green, white, grey
Shape: rectangular, cartoon bird's-eye view of a bedroom with a bed, rugs, a little chair and table, thin pink border, small and flat
Feel: playful, cheerful, imaginative, bright
Goes with: white kids' furniture, pastel walls, pink or green accents; children's bedrooms, nurseries, playrooms

product.name: RUMMET
product.description: The design shows the colourful interior of a house and your child can have fun playing on the rug with their dolls and doll furniture.
